memberdef.name: ndigo6g12_rsa_challenge_callback

briefdescription.para: Callback function signature for RSA challenge-response.

detaileddescription.para:
The driver calls this when the Ndigo board requests authentication. The hardware generates a random 32-byte secret and encrypts it with its public RSA-4096 key, producing a 512-byte challenge. The client application must decrypt this 512-byte challenge using their private key to recover and return the 32-byte secret.
challenge_data
Pointer to the buffer containing the 512-byte encrypted challenge.
challenge_length
Length of the challenge data in bytes (always NDIGO6G12_RSA_CHALLENGE_LENGTH).
signature_buffer
Pointer to the buffer where the client application stores the 32-byte decrypted response.
signature_length
On input: size of signature_buffer. On output: actual length of the response stored (must be NDIGO6G12_RSA_RESPONSE_LENGTH).
user_data
Optional user data pointer passed from ndigo6g12_authenticate.
0 on success, non-zero to abort authentication.

briefdescription.para: Acknowledge data.

detaileddescription.para: Acknowledge all data up to the packet provided as parameter. This is mandatory if ndigo6g12_read_in::acknowledge_last_read set to false for calls to ndigo6g12_read().

This feature allows to either free up partial DMA space early if there will be no call to ndigo6g12_read() anytime soon. It also allows to keep data over multiple calls to ndigo6g12_read() to avoid unnecessary copying of data.
